notes.title: Controller Support! v0.2.9 is here!
notes.content:
Welcome to v0.2.9, the first part of the massive upcoming update v0.3.0!

[list]
[*] Controller Support! Don't like keyboards? Just grab a controller and you're ready to go!
[*] 4 New Weapons! (2 Being Ultra Rare)
[*] New Weapon Skins
[*] New Player Skins
[*] Daily Lucky Chest in the lobby with exciting rewards!
[*] Daily Ad Chest with even MORE exciting rewards!
[*] Dynamic Footsteps
[*] Improved Weapon Sway Camera Effects
[*] Completely New Multiplayer Infrastructure for better match stability
[*] Fixed the major issue where the Round Timer would become longer than usual
[*] Improved Lighting and Graphics
[*] Game Storage decreased by around 50%
[*] Performance Increased by around 33%
[*] Various Balance Changes
[*] Enhanced Controls
[*] Altered Character Movement to allow more precise control and stability
[*] Changes the look of various environments
[*] Tons of Bug Fixes
[/list]

We've got a LOT in store for v0.3.0, let us cook for a li'l longer, and we promise you'll be surprised with what's coming. Got any ideas for Weapons, Maps, Skins, and anything else? Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/A9y9Gry3fQ]Discord Server[/url]! Update v0.3.0 will be delivered soon.

notes.title: Roadmap and From Developer to Player #1
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Ethan here, I'm the founder and Lead Developer of Pixel Royale 3D. I wanted to let you guys know what we plan on doing with the future of the game. No corporate garbage. Just from Developer to Player. I'll post the Roadmap here as well so you can get a nice idea of what's going to happen.

We made this game because there doesn't seem to be a game out there right now in the Pixel Shooter Genre that genuinely cares about the Game Ecosystem. I wanted to change that. The idea to bring this game to life started in Summer 2020, however I didn't start development until August 2022. I genuinely want to see a healthy game ecosystem where players are able to play with each other in a fun manner, without dealing with any of the modern game problems such as Pay-to-Win, power creep, FOMO, and a lot more you guys can name.

Anyways, this Announcement is to bring a new video/series to your attention: From Developer to Player. It's a new video series where I just sit down and talk to the players in a genuine manner, with a chance to be completely transparent with everyone. After all, the Developers are just one part of a whole.

I'll also post the roadmap down below.

Next Update is the First Part of v0.3.0. Called v0.2.9

Key Features
New-Gen Multiplayer infrastructure for better stability and lag control
Of course, major bug fixes
Game storage decreased by 50%
FPS Boost of ~25% in-game
A New Daily Chest that can be opened every 8 hours in the lobby.
A New Ultra-Rare Weapon
Other New Weapons
New Gun Skins
Flushed Dynamic Lighting
Ricochet
Overheat
General Framework and Preparations for v0.3.0

Key Features in v0.3.0 (Second Part)
NEW GAME MODE: Pixel Royale (You and up to 7 enemies fight from a pile of chests with a grace period to go loot up other areas and fight. Last one standing wins
Quests: Daily Quests where you can earn daily currencies
New Map: Stranded (for the Pixel Royale Game mode only)
New Weapons
New Gun Skins
A Testing Area to test weapons before you buy them
Controller Support
Health and Ammo Spawns

Plans for v0.4.0 (These and further are not absolute, can change or be scrapped)
Wear (Boots, Leggings, you get the idea): These can grant special effects, but at a cost. (ie Ice Boots: Grants extra speed, but the ground is slippery)
New Map (not explaining what it is, but it's very similar to an old CS map that's beloved
Of course, new weapons and skins

Plans for v0.5.0
Singleplayer (but can be co-op) ZOMBIES MODE: Fight waves of zombies to unlock perks, power, and escape! Board up windows to keep the zombies from entering!
Gear (ie Adrenaline: use it for a quick heal and speed boost)

Plans for v0.6.0 and beyond
Friends System
Parties System
Voice Chat
Events

notes.title: Introducing Content Battles!
notes.content:
Want Free Gems? Introducing Content Battles! Every Month, players can submit their own God-Like Clips to YouTube or TikTok, and have a chance to get featured, along with 250 Gems for FREE! That's right, make good plays, get good rewards! Want to participate? Here's the steps:

1. Clip an Awesome Moment In-Game

2. Upload that Clip to YouTube or TikTok with the Hashtag #PixelRoyale3DContentBattles

3. On the Last Day of every month, we'll announce the Winner!

These can range from simple clips to full on Killstreaks! The cooler, the better!

FAQ

1. There is no limit to submissions. Submit as many clips as you want!

2. You can NOT resubmit any clips that won. However, you CAN resubmit clips if you didn't win last month.

3. The First Winner will be picked at the end of June.

Good Luck!

notes.title: Pixel Royale 3D Arrives!
notes.content:
Pixel Royale 3D Open Beta is here! I should've marked this game as Early Access, but it slipped past my mind. Oh well. I want to thank everybody that supported the game pre-release. Now, as most of you know, there are quite a few pesky bugs infesting the game right now, and I would like to let you know that the team is working around the clock to fix these issues for you guys!

This is my first ever game I have developed. First [i]Ever[/i]. Because of that, there will most definitely be many bugs. If you do come across any bugs, PLEASE report them in the official Discord Server! Our goal is to have a seamless experience in-game, so if you have any feedback about any game mechs or ideas, let me know if the Discord! That's all, and I hope you enjoy the game!
